meta.case: a member unselects a poll answer

semantics.actor: d.user_id — Discord polls are never anonymous
semantics.source_time: none carried — receipt time only (arrival order via gateway s on the dispatch frame)
semantics.notes: A remove is per-answer, not a whole-vote withdrawal. Multi-select votes produce one event per answer; a voter's complete selection is only reconstructable across its per-answer events.
semantics.today: no listener subscription and no parser branch — the event never reaches capture
